decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-662 MODIFY requiring no-referral tickets to appear on the leaderboard and in NFT attributes.

The existing state already requires randomly allocated no-referral commissions to be included in visible totals and displayed on the dashboard, leaderboard, and in NFT attributes; the source reports that implementation remains unresolved rather than changing that requirement.
The source concerns commission and prize-ticket visibility, not public referral-count statistics.
Displaying no-referral commissions and tickets does not change the rule governing which owned NFTs appear in the dashboard inventory.
The source does not change how referral counts are displayed.
The source does not alter the counting basis or display requirements for public mint statistics.
Commission and ticket visibility does not change public prize-pool value reporting.
The source does not change the next-draw countdown label or its sales-remaining measure.
NFT attribute accounting is independent of NFT image and media rendering.
The source reports unresolved product-data visibility and does not request a change to FAQ explanations.
The source confirms that no-referral tickets are being sent and only identifies missing presentation; it does not change the existing random-recipient allocation rule.
The source does not request any change to the About page's explanation of no-referral rewards or prize mechanics.
